' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND B.MAIN_AC_CODE <> '' and A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND B.AC_REF_CODE = ' ? ' ?
